lessons.title: Lesson 1: Introduction to Programming Concepts
lessons.focus: What programming is, why we use it, and basic terminology like algorithm, code, and debugging

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Setting Up the Development Environment
lessons.focus: Installing a code editor, writing and running your first program, and understanding the file structure

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Variables and Data Types
lessons.focus: How to store information using variables, common data types (numbers, text, booleans), and naming conventions

lessons.title: Lesson 4: Basic Input and Output
lessons.focus: Reading user input, displaying results, and formatting output for clarity

lessons.title: Lesson 5: Control Flow – Conditionals
lessons.focus: Using if, else if, and else statements to make decisions in code

lessons.title: Lesson 6: Control Flow – Loops
lessons.focus: Repeating actions with while and for loops, and avoiding infinite loops

lessons.title: Lesson 7: Functions and Modularity
lessons.focus: Creating reusable blocks of code, passing arguments, and returning values

lessons.title: Lesson 8: Working with Collections
lessons.focus: Lists/arrays and dictionaries/maps, accessing, adding, and removing elements

lessons.title: Lesson 9: Simple Problem Solving Projects
lessons.focus: Applying learned concepts to build small programs such as a calculator or a quiz

lessons.title: Lesson 10: Debugging, Testing, and Next Steps
